name: zrndr_set_palette_remap_key
description: zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKey disables palette remapping for null recipes or packs recipe index and clamped shade bucket into g_zRndr_ActivePaletteRemapKey.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs produced symbol ?zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKey@@YIXPAUzVidPaletteRemapRecipe@@M@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x499930 after COFF relocation masking (24 relocation bytes, 10 trim nops; BN size 86, VC size 96).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x499930 shows null recipe sets g_zRndr_ActivePaletteRemapKey to -1; otherwise BuildPaletteVariant is called, shadeLevel01 is multiplied by 0.125f, converted to int, clamped to 0..31, and packed as (recipeIndex << 5) + shadeBucket.
The native smoke verifies null disable, negative shade clamp, high shade clamp, duplicate recipe reuse, and key packing.
